nodes.description: Private owner address; gates all onlyOwner functionality (minting, anti-bot blacklist, ownership transfer).
address=>bool blacklist mapping; a listed address is blocked from receiving tokens in _transfer.
Token balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested owner=>spender=>amount allowance mapping.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and reduced by _burn.
Token decimals, hardcoded to 18 in the ERC20 constructor.
Token name, set once at construction.
Token symbol, set once at construction.
Internal view returning msg.sender; single source of caller identity for the whole contract.
Public view returning the current _owner.
Modifier that requires _owner == _msgSender(); central access-control gate.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently locking owner-only features.
onlyOwner function delegating to _transferOwnership.
Internal routine that overwrites the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner function that writes arbitrary addresses into antiBotList, enabling blacklisting of recipients.
Internal transfer routine; enforces antiBotList[recipient] check and updates _balances.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer from _msgSender().
Public allowance-based transfer; calls _transfer then decrements allowance via _approve.
Public allowance setter forwarding to _approve.
Internal routine that overwrites _allowances entries.
Atomically increases caller allowance via SafeMath.add and _approve.
Atomically decreases caller allowance via SafeMath.sub and _approve.
onlyOwner function that mints new tokens to _msgSender().
Internal minting routine increasing _totalSupply and crediting _balances.
Internal burn routine reducing _balances and _totalSupply.
Internal burn-from routine combining _burn and allowance reduction.
Library helper that forwards arbitrary ETH via a low-level call to a recipient.
Private helper executing an arbitrary low-level call with value to an untrusted target.
Token constructor that mints 1e15*1e18 tokens entirely to the deploying msg.sender.
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public view returning _totalSupply.
External view returning owner().
Caller-controlled address; drives ownership checks, minting recipient and transfer source.
Low-level recipient.call{value:amount}('') forwarding all gas to an untrusted address.
Low-level target.call{value:weiValue}(data) on an arbitrary target with arbitrary calldata.
Unilateral antiBotList[addr] write by the owner, allowing arbitrary address censorship.
Unbounded supply creation through _mint; the single initial mint assigns the whole supply to the deployer.
Address argument of addOrRemoveFromBotList used as the antiBotList key.
Boolean flag of addOrRemoveFromBotList written into antiBotList.
Recipient argument of transfer.
Amount argument of transfer.
Sender argument of _transfer, debited in _balances.
Recipient argument of _transfer, also used to index antiBotList.
Amount argument of _transfer.
Owner-supplied amount of newly minted tokens.
New owner address passed to transferOwnership/_transferOwnership.
Spender argument of approve.
Allowance amount argument of approve.
Credited account argument of _mint.
Mint amount argument of _mint.
ETH recipient argument of sendValue, becomes call target.
ETH value argument of sendValue, becomes call value.
Arbitrary call target of _functionCallWithValue.
Arbitrary calldata of _functionCallWithValue.
ETH value forwarded by _functionCallWithValue.
Local variable in the Ownable constructor caching _msgSender() before assigning _owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by _msgSender().
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() before executing the guarded body.
_owner state variable is read inside the onlyOwner check.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
addOrRemoveFromBotList is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner.
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner state variable.
owner() reads _owner.
getOwner() forwards to owner().
addOrRemoveFromBotList performs the privileged antiBotList write.
addr parameter supplies the key for the blacklist write.
isAdd parameter supplies the value written into the blacklist.
antiBotList state variable is mutated by the privileged write.
_transfer requires !antiBotList[recipient], so blacklisting blocks token receipts.
recipient parameter indexes the antiBotList mapping.
sender parameter is debited inside _transfer.
amount parameter drives the SafeMath sub/add in _transfer.
_transfer updates _balances for sender and recipient.
transfer calls the internal _transfer.
recipient parameter enters transfer.
amount parameter enters transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
_msgSender() is used as the sender argument of transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
_allowances is read and decremented in transferFrom.
approve calls the internal _approve.
spender parameter enters approve.
amount parameter enters approve.
increaseAllowance calls _approve.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve.
_approve overwrites the _allowances entry.
mint calls the internal _mint.
owner-supplied amount enters mint.
amount is forwarded from mint into _mint.
mint credits _msgSender(), so the owner controls who receives new supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath.add, which reverts on overflow.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_mint performs new supply creation.
supply creation is reflected in _totalSupply.
BohemianBulldogs constructor invokes _mint for the initial supply.
The deploying msg.sender receives the entire initial minted supply.
account parameter selects the credited address in _mint.
amount parameter drives the supply and balance increase in _mint.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_burnFrom calls _burn.
_burnFrom calls _approve to consume allowance.
sendValue executes the low-level value call that transfers control to the recipient.
recipient parameter becomes the target of the low-level call.
amount parameter becomes the value of the low-level call.
recipient.call forwards all gas and can re-enter sendValue's caller before state finalization.
_functionCallWithValue executes the low-level call on the target.
target parameter is the untrusted call destination.
data parameter is the attacker-controlled calldata.
weiValue parameter is the value forwarded with the call.
The untrusted external call can re-enter the calling contract before the call returns.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
newOwner parameter enters the privileged transferOwnership function.
newOwner parameter is forwarded into _transferOwnership and written to _owner.
Caller identity determines whether the antiBotList write is permitted by onlyOwner.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is compared against _owner in the onlyOwner check.
The local msgSender is assigned from _msgSender() before _owner is set.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter addr is only used as the antiBotList key inside addOrRemoveFromBotList; collapse it into the owning function.
Parameter isAdd only feeds the blacklist write in addOrRemoveFromBotList.
Parameter recipient is the entry-point argument of the public transfer function.
Parameter amount is the entry-point argument of the public transfer function.
Parameter sender is an internal argument of _transfer and carries no separate semantics.
Parameter recipient is an internal argument of _transfer and drives the antiBotList lookup.
Parameter amount is an internal argument of _transfer.
Parameter amount is the only argument of the owner-restricted mint function.
Parameter newOwner is the entry-point argument of the privileged transferOwnership function.
Parameter spender is the entry-point argument of approve.
Parameter amount is the entry-point argument of approve.
Parameter account is an internal argument of the _mint routine.
Parameter amount is an internal argument of the _mint routine.
Parameter recipient becomes the call target of the unsafe low-level call in sendValue.
Parameter amount becomes the value transferred by the unsafe low-level call in sendValue.
Parameter target is the untrusted destination of the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
Parameter data is the untrusted calldata of the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
Parameter weiValue is the value forwarded by the unsafe low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
Local msgSender is merely a cached return value of the _msgSender helper and carries no independent meaning.
